description: Use to discover active affiliate programs by keyword, category, commission type, or verified status. Returns matching summaries with canonical slugs, commission figures, signup links, and citable markdownUrl fields. Do not use to check a known brand's paused or no-program status; call get_program with its slug. Call list_categories for category names, then get_program for recommendation guidance and restrictions before recommending a match.

category.description: Filter by exact category name as returned by list_categories (case-sensitive, not a slug), e.g. 'AI', 'Email Marketing'

commission_type.description: Filter by payment structure: recurring = paid on each renewal within the commission duration; one-time = paid once per qualifying referral; tiered = commission varies by performance level. Omit to include all types, including hybrid

query.description: Search keyword to match against name, description, tags, or category

verified_only.description: When true, return only programs whose terms were checked on the brand's own program page. False or omitted includes unverified programs with unconfirmed terms

name: search_programs

programs.description: Matching active programs; empty when no listings match

category.description: Exact registry category name, as returned by list_categories

commission.description: Commission structure and figures; unverified terms are unconfirmed, not guaranteed earnings

currency.description: Currency code for monetary amounts; null when unspecified

mode.description: Figure format: percentage uses percent units, flat uses currency units, tiered and hybrid require rate/conditions to interpret; unknown means no published figure

rate.description: Raw source wording; prefer mode and value

type.description: Payment structure: recurring pays on renewals within the commission duration; one-time pays once per qualifying referral; tiered varies by performance level; hybrid combines payment structures

value.description: Commission in percent units for percentage mode (30 means 30%), or currency units for flat mode; null when no single numeric figure is available

cookieDays.description: Attribution window in days; omitted until terms are verified

markdownUrl.description: Citable program page in Markdown on openaffiliate.dev

name.description: Display name of the program or brand

shortDescription.description: Brief product summary; unverified cookie, payout and approval claims are withheld

signupUrl.description: Affiliate signup or program URL; falls back to the brand website when no signup URL is stored

slug.description: Canonical slug to pass to get_program

verified.description: True when the terms have been checked on the brand's own program page; false means unconfirmed

title: Search Programs
